clearance.procedure: display-flipper-p25, all six checks, one session on 2026-09-18. (1) Host gate green. (2) Exact candidate on T-Display-P4 with C6 2.12.9 matching host 2.12.9. (3) Ten real LakeShark app opens and closes from the Flipper CLI (10/10, zero FuriCrash, CLI answering after each), a 300 s soak with the app open, and ten FM/P25 transitions; Wi-Fi joined during the run. (4) Display late-frame counters late=0 before and late=0 after, no transport errors, and board uptime monotonic across the whole session - 36 s to 4632 s by the end, no reset, no watchdog, and zero Guru/panic/assert/CORRUPT lines on either device. (5) Operator watched six app open/close cycles and reported no blue flashes, confirmed the touchscreen responded, and confirmed the audio was usable. (6) Four live calls decoded during the observed window - 2.5 s, 5.6 s, 8.4 s, 2.5 s - all bchFAIL=0 ok%=100, no P25TEL queue stall, and no stale speech waiting on a later call.

design_references.name: PortaPack Mayhem Capture
design_references.lesson: Shared capture workflow with explicit sample format, source tuning metadata, dropped-sample reporting and storage time estimates. Adapt to every capable LakeShark source; do not inherit a single-HackRF source assumption.

design_references.name: Mayhem RecordView
design_references.lesson: Common recording UI with format-specific writers and separate capture worker; explicit stop/error lifecycle. Reuse equivalent LakeShark infrastructure before adding workers/buffers. Do not copy hardware sample-rate or memory budgets.
